answer: The atlas lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the spiral is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, capped per identity per epoch, no identity may audit its own recruit. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the beacon of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
